description: Write msPKI-Enrollment-Flag on a certificate template, enabling ESC-style reconfiguration.

telemetry.detail: Template msPKI-Enrollment-Flag modification under DS-change auditing (default OFF).
Certificate request logged on the CA.
PKINIT TGT request with the issued certificate.

prerequisite_privilege: WriteProperty on the template's enrollment flag (or GenericWrite/GenericAll)
abuse_primitive: Clear manager-approval / alter enrollment flags, then enroll (ESC4 chain).
notes: A template-control primitive; feeds ESC4. Loud only where DS-change auditing is on.
